reviewer: Codex agent; provisional qualitative review, NOT independent human rating
human_review: not_run: no independent human reviewers participated
method: Read both actual outputs and internal policy probes. Scores describe proposed plans, not real action success. Mechanical scores remain frozen and separate. Physical proposals permitted by the contract can retain full goal scores while receiving a partial uncertainty score for lack of adaptation. No clinical or UI usability rating.
